description: Structure-anchored exopeptidase-loop census across human M1 peptidases, plus DYT31 allele mapping onto the AOPEP canonical sequence and AlphaFold model
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ================= A. Structure-anchored exopeptidase-loop census (fixes regex register) =============
HUMAN_M1 = {'ANPEP':'P15144','ENPEP':'Q07075','LNPEP':'Q9UIQ6','ERAP1':'Q9NZ08','ERAP2':'Q6P179',
 'NPEPPS':'P55786','TRHDE':'Q9UKU6','LVRN':'Q6Q4G3','RNPEP':'Q9H4A4','RNPEPL1':'Q9HAU8',
 'LTA4H':'P09960','AOPEP':'Q8N6M6'}
seq={n:''.join(requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
     for n,a in HUMAN_M1.items()}
rows=[]
for n,s in seq.items():
    h1=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r'HE..H',s) if m.start()+23<len(s) and s[m.start()+23]=='E'][0]
    # anchored window: 45 aa immediately N-terminal of H1, print it, and locate the conserved Met
    win=s[h1-46:h1-1]
    # the GXMEN Met sits 26 residues before H1 in LTA4H/AOPEP structural register
    anchored = s[h1-28:h1-22]          # 6-mer centred on the motif
    # exhaustive: does ANY Glu exist in the 45 aa loop window at a GXMEN-like context (xxMEN)?
    men = [m.start()+h1-46+1 for m in re.finditer(r'MEN',win)]
    rows.append(dict(protein=n, H1=h1, anchored_motif=anchored,
                     anchored_has_E = 'E' in anchored,
                     MEN_in_loop = ','.join(map(str,men)) if men else 'none'))
A=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print("A. Structure-anchored exopeptidase loop (6-mer at H1-27..H1-22) and MEN occurrences in the 45 aa loop:")
print(A.to_string(index=False)); print()

# ================= B. Dystonia alleles vs canonical sequence and distance to zinc =============
aop=seq['AOPEP']; print("B. AOPEP canonical length:",len(aop))
alleles={'p.Tyr206*':('Y',206),'p.Ala212Asp':('A',212),'p.Gly216Arg':('G',216),
         'p.Met291fs':('M',291),'p.Arg299*':('R',299),'p.Arg401Trp':('R',401),
         'p.Arg493*':('R',493),'p.Glu637*':('E',637)}
api=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8N6M6',timeout=120).json()
pdbtxt=requests.get(api[0]['pdbUrl'],timeout=180).text
ca={};plddt={};cb={}
for l in pdbtxt.split('\n'):
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        i=int(l[22:26]); xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        if l[12:16].strip()=='CA': ca[i]=xyz; plddt[i]=float(l[60:66])
        if l[12:16].strip() in ('CB','CA') and i not in cb: cb[i]=xyz
        if l[12:16].strip()=='CB': cb[i]=xyz
# zinc-site centroid from the three ligands H479/H483/E502 side-chain tips
tips={}
for l in pdbtxt.split('\n'):
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        i=int(l[22:26]); nm=l[12:16].strip()
        if (i,nm) in [(479,'NE2'),(483,'NE2'),(502,'OE2')]:
            tips[i]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
znc=np.mean([tips[k] for k in sorted(tips)],axis=0)
br=[]
for name,(aa,pos) in alleles.items():
    obs=aop[pos-1] if pos<=len(aop) else '?'
    d=float(np.linalg.norm(cb.get(pos,ca.get(pos,np.full(3,np.nan)))-znc)) if pos in ca else np.nan
    br.append(dict(allele=name, expected=aa, canonical_residue=obs, numbering_match=(obs==aa),
                   dist_to_Zn_site_A=round(d,1), pLDDT=round(plddt.get(pos,np.nan),1),
                   removes_catalytic_site = pos<479))
B=pd.DataFrame(br)
print("B. Reported DYT31/AOPEP alleles mapped onto the UniProt canonical 819 aa sequence and AlphaFold model:")
print(B.to_string(index=False))
print("\nZinc-ligand centroid used as the active-site reference; distances are CB-to-centroid.")

# ================= C. figure =============
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
order=[n for n in HUMAN_M1]
cols=['#c0392b' if n=='AOPEP' else '#34495e' for n in order]
ax[0].barh(range(len(order)),[1 if A.set_index('protein').loc[n,'anchored_has_E'] else 0 for n in order],color=cols)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(order)));ax[0].set_yticklabels([f"{n}  {A.set_index('protein').loc[n,'anchored_motif']}" for n in order],fontfamily='monospace')
ax[0].set_xticks([0,1]);ax[0].set_xticklabels(['absent','present'])
ax[0].set_title('Exopeptidase-motif glutamate in the 12 human M1 peptidases',fontsize=10)
ax[0].invert_yaxis()
d=B.dropna(subset=['dist_to_Zn_site_A'])
ax[1].scatter(d['dist_to_Zn_site_A'],d['pLDDT'],c=['#c0392b' if r else '#2980b9' for r in d['removes_catalytic_site']],s=70)
for _,r in d.iterrows(): ax[1].annotate(r['allele'],(r['dist_to_Zn_site_A'],r['pLDDT']),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax[1].set_xlabel('distance from zinc-ligand centroid (A)');ax[1].set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT')
ax[1].set_title('DYT31 alleles relative to the AOPEP zinc site',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
